Remark
[Type I curvature bound after rescaling] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0256, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0257 1. Equation 8.16\group dilations-of-finite-time-singularities

For each $\epsilon >0$, once $t_i$ is sufficiently close to $T$ one has \[ |\Rm _i(x,t)|\le \frac{\omega +\epsilon }{\omega _i-t} \] for all $x\in \mathcal M^n$ on the dilated time interval where the dilation is defined.
